title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 01 August 2026 Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 31 July 2026 Showers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western provinces and in Kandy, Nuwara-Eliya, Galle and Matara districts. Heavy falls above 100 mm are likely at some places. A few showers may occur in Matale, Anuradhapura and Hambantota districts. Mainly dry weather will prevail over the other areas of the island. Strong winds of about (40-50) kmph can be expected at times over Northern, North-central, Central, North-western and Sabaragamuwa provinces and in Monaragala, Hambantota and Trincomalee districts.
